label: Plain page
thesis: Match the privacy page: headings and prose on the grey ground, with the tour as a plain linked list. Cheapest and most consistent.
risk: Reads as a wall of text; the invitation to contribute sits last and is easy to miss.

label: Index card
thesis: Put the page on the act card with a plum About tab, sections divided by plum rules and a label column, and the invitation as a lavender strip.
risk: Borrows the act card, which means one act, so About may read as a band page.

label: Invitation first
thesis: Lead with a lavender strip and two pill buttons for writing in or adding a show, then plum bars for Why, What it does and Who.
risk: Puts the team after the pitch, and plum bars are meant for navigation, so it stretches the band-colour rules.
